name: Temptations Of Lust
source:
Currently you are living with your wife and sister in a different city than your parents. Your children are studying abroad.

Meeting your colleague's wife Debra starts a chain of events. Debra's husband is out of the country on a business trip, and she is currently living with her mother and sister in fear of the gang ruling the town.

The protagonist does not have all his memories, but after certain events, he will start recalling who he really is...
